description: Organisation maintains a documented AI governance policy and roles/responsibilities for AI risk management, including senior leadership accountability.
Legal and regulatory requirements involving AI are mapped, tracked, and understood by relevant staff.
Processes exist for workforce diversity, equity, and inclusion considerations in AI risk management decisions.
Organisational culture and incentives support critical thinking and safety-first mindset in AI system design, development, and deployment.
Mechanisms exist for external and internal stakeholders to provide feedback on AI systems throughout the lifecycle.
Policies address third-party AI risks, including data, software, and system dependencies from external suppliers.
Business and societal context of the AI system, including intended purpose and users, is documented and understood.
Categorisation of the AI system is performed, including capabilities, usage scenarios, and deployment context.
AI system risks and benefits are mapped for all identified users, stakeholders, and potentially impacted groups.
Risks and benefits from third-party components, including pre-trained models, data, and software, are mapped.
Appropriate methods and metrics are identified and applied to measure AI system trustworthiness characteristics.
AI system performance, including accuracy and robustness, is evaluated against defined benchmarks and use-case requirements.
Mechanisms for tracking identified AI risks over time are in place, including feedback from monitoring and incidents.
Fairness and bias in AI system outcomes are regularly assessed using appropriate methods for the context of use.
AI risks are prioritised and responded to based on the assessment results from the Measure function.
Mechanisms exist to sustain the value of deployed AI systems, including responding to changes in context or performance.
Processes exist to document and communicate residual AI risks to relevant stakeholders and decision-makers.
Incident response, recovery, and communication plans specific to AI system failures or unexpected behaviour are established.
